content.title: Patriots Day Parade | Laguna Beach, CA
content.text: About the Parade The Patriots Day Parade has taken place annually since 1967. The 2026 parade is scheduled for Saturday, March 14. Entries in this event range from civic and veterans’ organizations to school bands, floats, vintage automobiles, and novelty groups. The parade also honors citizens who have served the community and those who have served the nation in time of war or national emergency. How to Participate The Patriots Day Parade Association is a small group of dedicated volunteers. They welcome new members on their committee and are in search of volunteers to assist on the day of the parade. The ad and entry deadline is January 16, 2026. To enter a group or organization to march in the parade, or to advertise in the parade booklet, email Sandi Werthe at shworthy@cox.net or call (949) 494-6016. Parade Day The parade begins at Park Avenue and Legion Street, proceeds down Park Avenue, turns right on Glenneyre Street, right on Forest Avenue and ends just past City Hall. To accommodate the parade route as well as pedestrian traffic in the downtown area, portions of Forest Avenue, Ocean Avenue, Beach Street, 2nd Street, 3rd Street, Mermaid Street, Glenneyre Street, Short Street, Legion Street, Park Avenue and the Peppertree Parking Lot will be closed to vehicular traffic prior to and during the event. The weekly farmer’s market is cancelled due to the parade, and will resume the following Saturday.
